driving_question: The incommunicability axiom: does any book hand over the lead-to-gold procedure, or do they all just describe the gap? (q0124, deep-read of Technic and Magic, run 10/14)
book: Technic and Magic: The Reconstruction of Reality (Federico Campagna)
best_collision: Campagna's total language (c02010: a frame that denies legitimacy to whatever isn't the frame denies any possibility of reality) collides with Noble's captured refusal (q0106 territory: contestation becomes the platform's content) — refusal is either captured as content or expelled from presence; the two books give the same machine two different punishments
quote: While absolute existence lies beyond the grasp of any form of societal control, presence in the world in the age of Technic becomes the prime object of production and of policing. (p.44)
mutation_note: Translation needed an outside to work on; total language ate the outside and now polices presence case by case — big data, finance, neuroscience, citizenship, identity are one selection. The LLM is this machine as an engine: a closed sphere of writing with no outside to translate, so its hallucination may be the crisis of reality run at machine scale — and the 4chan haunting is that crisis felt from inside the sphere.
